timeline.text: Started BSc Computer Science at Kabarak University, Nakuru, Kenya — built a foundation in algorithms, systems, data structures, and software engineering. Early projects included CPIMS codebase upgrade (Python 2.7/Django 1.8 → Python 3.10/Django 4.0) and NLP/AI exploration.

Joined Ruel Software as Software Support & Implementation Specialist Intern — first professional role supporting Ruel Enterprise ERP deployment across 700+ client organizations. Progressed to full-time Software Engineer, delivering KRA eTIMS government compliance integration.
Completed role at Ruel Software. Deepened AI and systems integration skills — ASR research, NLP pipelines, and preparation for production AI engineering work.

Joined BITZ IT Consulting Ltd. as Software Engineer — working on OpenCHS AI platform across East Africa. Built a production containerized AI pipeline (Whisper, translation, NLP, FastAPI, Celery, Docker) for child protection organizations.
Advancing toward AI product leadership — building AI-enabled products, contributing to Digital Public Infrastructure initiatives, and growing toward AI Product Management and technology leadership.
